SEEKING TO QUASH THE ORDER DATED 12.11.2019 WITH RESPECT TO FORFEITURE OF BAIL BOND AND ISSUANCE OF ORDER OF PROCLAMATION AGAINST THE PETITIONERS/ACCUSED NO.1, 2, 3 AND 6 IN CC NO.1755/2016 PENDING ON THE FILE OF JMFC-II,
HUBBALLI REGISTERED FOR THE OFFENCES PUNISHABLE U/S 498A,
323, 504, 506 R/W 34 OF IPC AND SECTION 3 AND 4 OF DOWRY PROHIBITION ACT.
 -3-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:13033  CRL.P No. 102200 of 2022  THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
This petition is filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C praying to quash the order dated 12.11.2019 passed in C.C.No.1755/2016 by learned JMFC-II, Hubballi.

The said order reads as under;
"Accused No.1 to 4 & 6 are absent.
Surety notice of A-1 to 4 & 6 issued through RPAD is S/p on 08.11.2019 as per net status.
Called out, absent.
The bail bond and surety bond of Accused No.1 to 4 & 6 is hereby cancelled.
The bail bond and surety bond amount of Rs.25,000/- each is hereby forfeited to the state.

Office to register separate Crl.Misc case against Accused No.1 to 4 & 6 as well as his surety stood for Accused No.1 to 4 & 6 for recovery of forfeited bond amount.
Issue proclamation against Accused No.1 to 4 & 6 as per Sec.82 of Cr.P.C by 31.12.2019."

NC: 2023:KHC-D:13033 facing trial for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504,
506, 143, 144, 145, 147, 148 read with Section 149 of Indian Penal Code.
The order which is subject matter of this petition is passed by JMFC-II Court, Hubballi and it is the order revisable by the Sessions Court.
There is a remedy for these petitioners to challenge the said order dated 12.11.2019 before the Sessions Court.
Therefore when there is a specific remedy, the petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C seeking quashing of the said order is not maintainable.
Hence, the criminal petition is dismissed.
